segments.text: Ok so, this is the headless interrupts page in the CopilotKit docs, for Google Antigravity with React, and I've implemented it in my project.
My project, with the exact page and hook from the doc. App Surface isn't defined anywhere, so I added a small harness one.

Moving on to the demo. So the page loads, and on the left the harness App Surface says no pending interrupt. In the chat I asked the agent to book a call with the sales team. And umm, the agent does call the schedule meeting tool, and the run stops on the interrupt, like it should.
But the surface never picks it up, it still says no pending interrupt. So the backend is fine, and uh, the problem is on the frontend.
The hook waits for the old on interrupt event, but Antigravity sends the standard interrupt, umm, so the hook never sees it.
So pending stays null, nothing renders, and the run is just stuck.
Back on the doc. The browser page says not supported on Google Antigravity, but the markdown export still ships this code.
And the page renders App Surface, which is never defined, so as written it crashes.

So noting it down. One, App Surface is not defined, so the page crashes. Two, even with a surface added, the hook listens for the old on interrupt event, so umm, Antigravity's interrupt never shows. And the interrupt headless agent is also never registered.
And this is the console, with the errors from the run. So yeah, please take a look and fix this.
